preconditions.description: The number of distinct scores m is between 1 and 31.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= ai <= 30 for ai in S)
preconditions.description: Each score ai in the set S is between 0 and 30.
All elements in the set S are distinct.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '=(' or (isinstance(return_value, tuple) and len(return_value) == 2 and isinstance(return_value[0], int) and return_value[0] >= len(S) and isinstance(return_value[1], list) and len(return_value[1]) == return_value[0] and all(isinstance(row, str) and len(row) == return_value[0] and all(c in '01' for c in row) for row in return_value[1]))
postconditions.description: The output is either '=(' or a tuple (n, matrix) where n is the number of vertices and matrix is an n x n matrix of '0's and '1's representing the tournament.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '=(' or all(row[i] == '0' for row, i in zip(return_value[1], range(return_value[0])))
postconditions.description: If the output is a tournament matrix, the main diagonal contains only '0's.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '=(' or set(sum(int(row[j]) for row in return_value[1]) for j in range(return_value[0])) == set(S)
postconditions.description: If the output is a tournament matrix, the set of scores in the tournament matches the set S.
